killedBy: the three developer actions (issue #252) re-asks whether a round exists every time the pane opens, not only at registration
why: Decides whether the three controls are offered ONCE, when the port is registered -- which `route-host.ts` does at construction, while the session is still at its own title screen and `hasRound()` is false. All three would then stay hidden for the entire life of the page, and the feature would ship invisible. Whether a round exists changes underneath a pane that is shut, so the question has to be re-asked when it opens. The pane-open path grew a `refreshNamespace()` call beside it under issue #249, so the find string grew with it; the mutation still removes only the availability refresh.
